name: Gyöngyösmellék (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Gyöngyösmellék (a blue shield with a white figure of the Virgin and a wavy yellow stripe) within a wreath of grapevine.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
